tools.name: get_tape
tools.description: Cash-market close price vs the on-chain price on Aero (formerly Aerodrome) for the Coinbase tokenized stocks Afterbook tracks on Base — basis in bp and real pool depth. Read-only; no wallet is ever involved.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Estimate shares out, execution price, and price impact for sizing a USDC -> stock trade on one of the tracked pools. tools.name: get_basis_stats
tools.description: How big the basis typically gets while the cash market is NOT open, over the last 30 days — mean, mean absolute, and max absolute basis in bp, sampled every 5 minutes off real traffic. Returns null if there is not enough sampled history yet.

tools.name: make_plan
tools.description: A checked trade plan for Coinbase tokenized stocks on Base: for each stock a buy, wait or skip verdict with reasons (gap to the real stock, stale pool, earnings, depth) and a size within your cost limit, $25k and 10% of the pool. Returns planUrl, a link where a person opens the plan on afterbook.app

tools.name: make_basket
tools.description: A 2-4 stock basket of Coinbase tokenized stocks on Base from a theme or sectors: the code picks the deepest steady pools that pass the checks and sizes them within your budget and cost limit, with every dropped stock and why.
